def solution():
    # Define variables
    face_value = 1000.0
    current_one_year_rate = 0.08
    up_rate = 0.10
    down_rate = 0.06
    probability_each = 0.50
    annual_risk_premium = 0.004

    # Discount the expected year-1 bond value using the current rate,
    # with the duration risk premium added to each year's rate.
    expected_year1_discount_factor = (
        probability_each / (1 + up_rate + annual_risk_premium)
        + probability_each / (1 + down_rate + annual_risk_premium)
    )
    bond_value = (
        face_value
        * expected_year1_discount_factor
        / (1 + current_one_year_rate + annual_risk_premium)
    )

    # Return the valuation rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_value, 3)
